description_en: Modifies an outbound security group rule
description_zh: 本接口用于修改一条出方向安全组规则
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-security-group-egress-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityGroupEgressRule

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source security group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 源端安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679845.html operation to query the ID of the security group rule
parameters.help_zh: 安全组规则ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679845.html 查询安全组规则ID
parameters.name: security_group_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The access permissions. Valid values:

accept: Allows access.
drop: deny access and does not return a rejection message.

Default value: accept
parameters.help_zh:
访问权限。取值范围：

accept：接受访问。
drop：拒绝访问，不返回拒绝信息。

默认值：accept
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the security group rule. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
安全组规则优先级。取值范围：1~100。

默认值：1
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The network layer or transport layer protocol. Two types of values are supported:
Case-insensitive protocol names. Valid values:
ICMP
GRE
TCP
UDP
ALL: all protocols.
Protocol numbers that comply with the IANA standard, which are integers from 0 to 255. Available regions:
Philippines
UK
Malaysia
Hohhot
Qingdao
US West
Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
网络层/传输层协议。支持两类赋值：
不区分大小写的协议名。取值范围：
ICMP
GRE
TCP
UDP
ALL：支持所有协议。
符合IANA规范的协议号取值，即0 到 255的整数。目前开放的地域列表：
菲律宾
英国
马来西亚
呼和浩特
青岛
美西
新加坡
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The destination IPv4 Classless Inter-Domain Routing. IPv4 address ranges in CIDR format and IPv4 format are supported.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
目的端IPv4 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。

默认值：无
parameters.name: dest_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
The destination IPv6 Classless Inter-Domain Routing. IPv6 address ranges in CIDR format and IPv6 format are supported.

Only VPC-type IP addresses are supported. This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be specified in Settings at the same time.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
目的端IPv6 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

仅支持VPC类型的IP地址，且该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。

默认值：无
parameters.name: ipv6_dest_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination security group for which you want to configure the access permissions. You must specify at least one of the Settings for `DestGroupId` or `DestCidrIp`.

You must specify at least one of the DestGroupId, DestCidrIp, Ipv6DestCidrIp, and DestPrefixListId parameters.
If you specify DestGroupId but do not specify DestCidrIp, the NicType parameter can only be set to intranet.
If you specify both DestGroupId and DestCidrIp, DestCidrIp takes precedence by default
parameters.help_zh:
需要设置访问权限的目的端安全组ID。至少设置一项`DestGroupId`或者`DestCidrIp`参数。

至少设置DestGroupId、DestCidrIp、Ipv6DestCidrIp或DestPrefixListId参数中的一项。
如果指定了DestGroupId没有指定参数DestCidrIp，则参数NicType取值只能为intranet。
如果同时指定了DestGroupId和DestCidrIp，则默认以DestCidrIp为准
parameters.name: dest_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination prefix list. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html operation to query the IDs of available prefix lists.

If you specify one of the `DestCidrIp`, `Ipv6DestCidrIp`, or `DestGroupId` parameters, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
目的端前缀列表ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html查询可以使用的前缀列表ID。

当您指定了`DestCidrIp`、`Ipv6DestCidrIp`或者`DestGroupId`参数中的一个时，将忽略该参数
parameters.name: dest_prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en:
The range of destination ports that are open for the transport layer protocol. Valid values:

For the TCP or UDP protocol: 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port. Example: 1/200.
For the ICMP protocol: -1/-1.
For the GRE protocol: -1/-1.
For ALL: -1/-1
parameters.help_zh:
目的端安全组开放的传输层协议相关的端口范围。取值范围：

TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: port_range

parameters.help_en:
The source IPv4 Classless Inter-Domain Routing. IPv4 address ranges in CIDR format and IPv4 format are supported.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
源端IPv4 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。

默认值：无
parameters.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
The source IPv6 Classless Inter-Domain Routing. IPv6 address ranges in CIDR format and IPv6 format are supported.

Only VPC-type IP addresses are supported. This parameter and the `SourceCidrIp` parameter cannot be specified in Settings at the same time.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

仅支持VPC类型的IP地址，且该参数与`SourceCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。

默认值：无
parameters.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
The range of source ports that are open for the transport layer protocol. Valid values:

For the TCP or UDP protocol: 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port. Example: 1/200.
For the ICMP protocol: -1/-1.
For the GRE protocol: -1/-1.
For ALL: -1/-1
parameters.help_zh:
源端安全组开放的传输层协议相关的端口范围。取值范围：

TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account to which the destination security group belongs when you configure the security group rule across accounts
parameters.help_zh: 跨账户设置安全组规则时，目的端安全组所属的阿里云账户
parameters.name: dest_group_owner_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the destination security group belongs when you configure the security group rule across accounts
parameters.help_zh: 跨账户设置安全组规则时，目的端安全组所属的阿里云账户ID
parameters.name: dest_group_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The network interface controller (NIC) type.


This parameter cannot be modified when you modify a rule by specifying the security group rule ID. To modify this parameter, add a new rule and then delete the current rule
parameters.help_zh:
网卡类型。


根据安全组规则ID修改规则时，不支持修改该参数。如果需要修改，建议先增加一条新规则，再删除当前规则
parameters.name: nic_type

parameters.example: This is a new securitygroup rule.
parameters.help_en: The description of the security group rule. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 安全组规则的描述信息。长度为1~512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the port list.
You can call the `DescribePortRangeLists` operation to query the IDs of available port lists.

If you specify the PortRange parameter, this parameter is ignored.

For more information, see [Security group limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
parameters.help_zh:
端口列表 ID。
您可以调用`DescribePortRangeLists`查询可以使用的端口列表 ID。

当您指定了PortRange参数时，将忽略该参数。

更多信息，请参见[安全组使用限制](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
parameters.name: port_range_list_id
